nudge-smoke-01.description: Smoke test of the nudge loop only (rounds=0, nudges<=2, doc v1, minimax-m2.7). Aborted after 4 tasks once the loop was seen to fire — it was never meant to finish, so its 4/71 is not a result.

phase3-holdout-02.description: First full 3-arm holdout sweep (Aven vs Python vs Ruby, 71 tasks each) on minimax-m2.7 with skill doc v1. Establishes the cross-language delta the campaign exists to measure.

phase3-holdout-03.description: Same 3-arm holdout as -02 but on deepseek-v4-flash, with the nudge loop enabled (nudges<=2). Changes the model and adds nudging at once, so it is not a clean single-variable comparison against -02.

phase3-holdout-04.description: Aven arm only, on skill doc v2 and a compiler carrying the first round of benchmark-driven fixes (aven-lang e8a71f9). Drops the control arms to iterate faster on the Aven side.

phase3-holdout-05.description: Aven arm on aven-lang 430af37 with regenerated suites. Scored 95.5% pass / 53.7% first-shot after a retry pass corrected a selection bias (the excluded harness errors were disproportionately the previously-failing tasks). Remaining failures: complex-numbers, react, rest-api, alphametics. NOTE: measured the original memorisable zebra-puzzle, which was retired from holdout on 2026-08-01.

phase3-holdout-06.description: Re-baseline of holdout-05's configuration on aven-lang 86ee877, seven fixes newer (match-arm block bodies, undefined-default inference, array equality coercion, native Array.length, checker equality parity, S6 empty-element traversal, compact). Also raises the agent timeout 900s -> 1800s (fixes timeouts misfiled as dead-provider errors) and swaps in zebra-puzzle-generated. Purpose: know where failures sit on the current compiler before the diagnostic-format A/B. Scored 90.1% pass / 59.2% first-shot over 71 tasks after retrying ledger (harness error -> pass) and drawing a second sample for prism (agent timeout -> pass 14/14). Against holdout-05 only three tasks moved: react fixed (parse_error -> pass), prism lost to an agent stall, pov exposed a pre-existing checker hole where ambient methods do not satisfy open-row receiver constraints.

phase3-pilot-01.description: Phase 3 pilot: 10 tune tasks, 3 arms, 1 model, skill doc v0. Shakedown of the 3-arm pipeline end to end before committing to a full holdout sweep.
